retrieval_policy.title: Choose retrieval by the missing information
retrieval_policy.when: Before each retrieval decision, identify what information is missing from the question and visible evidence.
action_sequence: Use semantic_search when the needed information is conceptual, relational, or its wording is unknown.
Use entity_hop when a concrete entity is available and a direct entity-based corpus lookup may find the missing passage.
Use linear_hop when a concrete entity is available and the missing information may require following connected sentence, entity, or passage links.
When both hops are plausible, choose according to the observed evidence and question; do not call both automatically.

retrieval_policy.title: Inspect retrieval results
retrieval_policy.when: After semantic_search, entity_hop, or linear_hop returns snippets.
action_sequence: Treat snippets as retrieval leads, not complete evidence.
Use read_chunk on the returned chunks that may answer the missing part.

retrieval_policy.title: Stop when the evidence is sufficient
retrieval_policy.when: The read evidence answers every required part of the question.
action_sequence: Use stop_and_answer and answer only from the observed evidence.
